## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      1 avis récent mentionne prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 sept. 2026 - 10 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Thursday_, 10 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I've used MFP for over a decade. It used to be the perfect app, but with each update they made it harder to navigate, more and more cumbersome, and they keep taking features we already had and putting them behind a paywall. The app used to be laid out so you could easily see all of your information right up front. Now you have to dig to try to find anything."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 sept. 2026 - 10 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Natalie Kirk_, 10 sept. 2026, 4/5: "It's been good. Except today, it has started showing me ads with music! On my food journal entry log! Specifically Candy Crush ads with no option to mute them!!! PLEASE REMOVE ADS WITH SOUND. I DO NOT WANT BAD MUSIC BLASTING FOR EVERYONE TO HEAR WHILE I'M AT A CAFÉ ENTERING MY LUNCH!!!!!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      6 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 6 mai 2026 - 12 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _ben rothan_, 10 sept. 2026, 1/5: "In the past I used this app years ago to track my calories and other metrics so I could lose weight. I lost around 50 lbs at the time, even getting some lingering health issues cleared up. Recently I decided to use this app again. However they have now moved some features that used to be standard into the "premium" subscription, to include the barcode scanner. This "premium" feature now costs $20 a month and is not worth it. If there are better apps, I'd suggest using them instead of this."
            2. _enka cacka_, 21 août 2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Ein Google-Nutzer_, 16 août 2026, 1/5: "Demands an insane amount of access to your personal data. Also, the amount of ads has increased to a level that makes the app unusable."
<!--/ir-theme-->
